card.name: Forms of the verb imply
card.fires_on: The verb imply and its forms (implied, implies, implying), mostly in statements about what something does or does not suggest. It often follows "not" or "does not".

modes.label: Negated implication
modes.description: Imply after not or does not, to deny that a meaning or conclusion follows.
modes.example: Advertising does not<< imply>> endorsement,agreement or approval of any

modes.label: Positive implication
modes.description: Implied, implies or implying used to say what a statement or fact suggests or entails.
modes.example: There are paintings and designs on the wall<< implying>> a religious message.

modes.label: Implied as a modifier
modes.description: Implied used as an adjective in the sense of unstated, as in implied powers.
modes.example: the Hamiltonian, or “doctrine of<< implied>> powers.”
